Reference / http/cookie_date

http/cookie_date#

Cookie dates: the forgiving Expires grammar of RFC 6265bis.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

ParsedCookieDate("Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT").instant();
ParsedCookieDate("21-Oct-15 07:28:00").instant();

Description#

Cookie dates: the forgiving Expires grammar of RFC 6265bis.

Weekdays and zone names are ignored and two-digit years get a fixed century (70-99 → 19xx, 00-69 → 20xx). No locale or clock is read.

Public API#

object ParsedCookieDate#

object ParsedCookieDate

RFC 6265bis draft-22 cookie-date token algorithm. Weekday/timezone words are ignored, two-digit centuries are fixed and no ambient locale/clock is read.

ParsedCookieDate.ParsedCookieDate#

ParsedCookieDate(origin is string)

The text of an Expires attribute.

ParsedCookieDate.instant#

instant() is Instant

The instant; InvalidCookieDate when the text has no date.
